observation: During acceptance, /sys/class/tty/tty0/active was tty6 while loginctl placed the sole graphical session 5 on tty2. grim timed out with exit124 and the artifact directory was empty. Menu/screenshot assertions failed; installed Neovim and system checks passed.
cause: Agent QMP bootstrap recovery selected tty6; a late second intervention used the socket reused by the acceptance VM and left the graphical session inactive. Do not attribute these menu/capture failures to product behavior.
action: Preserve original failed acceptance log/screenshots and rerun acceptance in a fresh overlay without manual VT intervention. New dynamic-console harness will also be exercised by a fresh encrypted installation.
